sentences.en: I was fourteen when my family moved to another country.
sentences.zh: 我十四岁的时候，我的家人搬到了另一个国家。

sentences.en: He was kept prisoner in North Korea for fourteen years.
sentences.zh: 他在朝鲜被囚禁了十四年。

sentences.en: Fourteen passengers are squeezed into the back of the truck.
sentences.zh: 卡车后面挤进了十四个乘客。
